name: Gästehaus am Graben
beschreibung:
Nestled at the base of the Hahnenkamm mountain in Hoefen, Gaestehaus am Graben provides restful holiday days in the Reutte Nature Park region. The family-run guesthouse offers cosy rooms and friendly personal hospitality.

The Hahnenkamm cable car, the celebrated Lechweg trail, and the high-flying Highline179 suspension bridge are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus am Graben in Hoefen offers peaceful accommodation with mountain vistas in the Reutte Nature Park region.
